gloss: full stomach; bellyful; to one's heart's content

definitions.explanation: The state of having eaten enough to be completely full. A direct, somewhat casual way to describe satiety.

definitions.gloss: to one's heart's content; as much as one wants
definitions.explanation: Doing something to the fullest extent, without restraint.

examples.japanese: {腹一杯|はらいっぱい}⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate until I was full.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{腹一杯|はらいっぱい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}けない→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: I'm so full I can't move.

examples.japanese: ⟦バイキング→バイキング：21783_baikingu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{腹一杯|はらいっぱい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate at the buffet until I was stuffed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腹一杯|はらいっぱい}⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I played to my heart's content on my day off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{腹一杯|はらいっぱい}⟦{吸|す}い{込|こ}んだ→吸い込む：06984_suikomu⟧。
examples.english: I breathed in fresh air to my lungs' full capacity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腹一杯|はらいっぱい}⟦{楽|たの}しんで→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ほしい。
examples.english: I want the children to enjoy themselves to the fullest.

notes:
{腹一杯|はらいっぱい} means completely full (stomach), having eaten to capacity.

ALTERNATE FORMS:
- ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧いっぱい: common mixed writing
- ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧いっぱい: softer, more polite variant (uses ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧ instead of ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {腹一杯|はらいっぱい}⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat until completely full
- {腹一杯|はらいっぱい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become completely full
- ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧いっぱいです: I'm full (polite)

FORMS:
⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧ (stomach, belly) + ⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧ (full). Literally "stomach full."

USAGE:
Implies satisfied fullness from eating. Can also be used figuratively: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{腹一杯|はらいっぱい}だ can mean "I've had enough" (of a situation).
